data.title: JD Vance Is Right About The Dollar. Bitcoin Solves The Triffin Dilemma
data.description: The world may continue using dollars because American markets are deep, liquid, and useful, but it no longer has to make America's debt the foundation of global money.
data.author: Dave Birnbaum
data.keywords: United States,Robert Triffin,Washington,JD Vance,JD Vance Is Right
